Snapshot peer selection API and peer, slot, and score data types.

# Purpose
This header declares the snapshot peer selector interface used to choose the best peer for snapshot download. It defines the data types `fd_ssinfo_t`, `fd_sscluster_slot_t`, and `fd_sspeer_t`, which store resolved snapshot slot data, cluster slot state, and the selected peer record. The API provides functions to create, join, leave, delete, add, remove, and query peers, as well as to update cluster slot state and select the best peer with [`fd_sspeer_selector_best`](<#fd_sspeer_selector_best>). The selector uses peer address, latency, and snapshot slot information to score peers and to keep track of the most recent full and incremental snapshot slots seen in the cluster.
